determinism.verification: pdf-reproducibility compares the verified published candidate with one isolated candidate tree using every file SHA-256

safety.source_copy: Each DITA conversion receives an isolated copy of documentation/src and documentation/assets.
safety.source_immutability: The generator compares source and asset SHA-256 values before and after all conversions.
safety.delivery_boundary: This generator writes only documentation/build/pdf. BPM093-M14-09 alone promotes a validated candidate into distributions/documentation/{bpm_version}.

parallelism.decision: Retain one ordered worker: verified pair reuse removes unchanged renderer work, while concurrent Chromium instances would multiply peak RSS on the measured two-core target without helping cache hits.
